answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 15966 Country: India Title: Assalam O alaykum sahab, i am working in the gulf for past 3 years i had lended a big part of my earnings to one of my best friend, but now even the tenure for returning the money as committed is over, i am not even getting any reply or assurance from him, when i need the money very urgently. please advice. Question: Assalam O alaykum sahab, i am working in the gulf for past 3 years i had lended a big part of my earnings to one of my best friend, but now even the tenure for returning the money as committed is over, i am not even getting any reply or assurance from him, when i need the money very urgently. please advice. Answer ID: 15966 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1690/1382/D=1430) Recite the following dua after every salah: اللھم اکفنی بحلالک عن حرامک واغننی بفضلک عمن سواک (2) Perfrom two rak?ah as Salatul Hajah and pray to Allah, the debt will be repaid to you in-shaAllah. Also, recite Ya Muizz ( یا معز ) after Isha 1100 times with durood 11 times before and after. Then, supplicate to Allah for payment of debt, you will succeed in your motto in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
